text: 【房贷最长期限延长至40年 已有银行开通申请】8月28日，人民银行、金融监管总局联合发布房地产信贷管理新规，其中提到，个人住房贷款最长期限延长至40年。中国证券报记者近日调研了解到，已有银行开通申请。
text_en: Mortgage Maximum Term Extended to 40 Years, Some Banks Open Applications: On Aug 28, the PBOC and the National Financial Regulatory Administration jointly issued new rules on real estate credit management, extending the maximum term for individual housing loans to 40 years. A China Securities Journal reporter learned in recent research that some banks have already opened applications.
